metadata.title: Fish Curry without tomato in Santali style | मछली बिना टमाटर के संथाली स्टाईल में पकी
metadata.description: Santhal is one of the largest tribal groups in India. we travelled to Santal pargana region of Jharkhand to meet the people of this tribe. During our visit we explored their food and rare recipes. Today we bring to you an episode of the tribal kitchen prepared with a Adivasi family in Dumka district.
